svg.title: Multi-Raft on Cell Groups — replication rationale
svg.desc: A leader prepares a private SQLite transaction and captures cell-addressed LTX page changes. One group log replicates updates for many cells to three voters. Committed entries update the selected cell image on each replica. Image and manifest synchronization precedes atomic root and applied-index publication. Groups share node infrastructure while retaining independent elections. Cells retain separate databases but share group leadership, placement and apply order. This is the shared-group target architecture; production cutover is pending.
svg.text: Many SQLite databases. One consensus log per group.
One leader · one membership · one ordered log
Separate SQLite state, transactions and versions
Many groups share workers, storage and transport
B identity + base/result version + changed pages
